color-system.twistDescription: No twist — copied verbatim. pageBackground #f5f2ee (luminance 242.4 > 190 threshold, qualifies for light register). Warm parchment ground.

type-system.twistDescription: B. Letter spacing injection at intensity 3 — added --font-letter-spacing-heading: 0.06em applied to display and heading scale tokens. All proprietary fonts from teenage-engineering source replaced with Google Fonts CDN: Archivo (display/headings) and Inter (body/ui). No woff2 references in CSS output.

motion-system.twistDescription: A. Duration scaling (slower) ×1.5 at intensity 3 — all numeric durations multiplied: 0.234s→0.351s, 0.351s→0.527s, 0.468s→0.702s, 1.17s→1.755s, 0.585s→0.878s, 3.276s→4.914s, 1.404s→2.106s. Produces a measured, unhurried pacing — animations that feel considered rather than automatic.

grid-system.twistDescription: A. Container max-width tightened 15% at intensity 3 — stripe's 1298px container reduced to 1103px. Column widths scaled proportionally from 88px to 74px. More editorial focus, less immersive spread. kreor source was too sparse; stripe selected for richer grid structure.

spacing-system.twistDescription: B. Section-specific breathing room +32px at intensity 3 — section gap increased from 32px to 64px (rowGap and columnGap). All other spacing values unchanged from folio-arc source (which already had hero padding at ×1.5 scale). Creates generous section separation.

interaction-states.twistDescription: D. Hover opacity at 0.75 (intensity 3) — all link, navigation, and card hover states receive opacity: 0.75. Transition durations aligned with motion system's --motion-duration-fast (0.527s). Interactive elements step back quietly on hover — acknowledgment without drama.

nav-system.twistDescription: A. Nav height slimmer -10px at intensity 3 — stripe's 64px height reduced to 54px. Logo position remains left. Nav recedes from structural prominence into functional transparency.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Tone twist applied to final paragraph of concept_by_image.md — shifted from technical specification register to more restrained, material register. concept_by_video.md generated fresh: hero workspace video, process hands loop, editorial paper/light section. All video placements reflect the warm-parchment aesthetic and measured motion character of the assembled system.
